title: Médico Nefrologista em Telemedicina (com RQE)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Médico Nefrologista em Telemedicina (com RQE) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"  Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!  A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Nefrologia!  Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Nefrologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos. *PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*  Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.   Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.  Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.  Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.  Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.  Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.  Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.   Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.  Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.  Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.  Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.  Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.  Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.   Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.  Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.   REQUISITOS  Formação Acadêmica:  Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA.  Certificações:  Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE  (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado); Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);  Experiência:   Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina. Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:   Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos. Competências Comportamentais:  Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes:   Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho:  REMOTO Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo. IMPORTANTE:  MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:  Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you’re passionate about making an impact, we’d love to have you on board. title: Promo Team Lead - Brazil
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Promo Team Lead - Brazil em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About Pocket FM  Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens. At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview  We are looking for a creative and execution-focused Promo Team Lead  to lead the end-to-end creation of promotional ads, trailers, and performance creatives for Pocket FM audio series in the Brazilian market. As a Promo Team Lead, you will manage a team of promo writers, sound engineers, video editors, and dubbing partners to create high-quality promotional ads for Pocket FM audio series. The role requires strong understanding of promo creation, ad storytelling, localization, dubbing workflows, quality control, team management, and creative optimization. You will oversee fresh promo creation, adaptation of ads from other geographies into Brazilian Portuguese, production quality, timely delivery, and reworks for ads that are not meeting performance benchmarks. Key Responsibilities  1. Team Leadership & Creative Direction  Lead and guide promo writers, sound engineers, video editors, and external dubbing partners. Provide creative direction across writing, dubbing, audio mixing, video editing, and final delivery. Ensure the team is well-utilized, motivated, and aligned with business and creative goals. Build a high-ownership culture focused on quality, speed, and performance.  2. Promo Creation & Localization  Oversee the creation of fresh promo ads, trailers, and long-form promotional scripts for audio series. Adapt successful ads from other geographies into Brazilian Portuguese. Ensure all promos are culturally relevant, emotionally engaging, and suitable for Brazilian audiences. Guide the team on hooks, story setup, emotional beats, cliffhangers, and audience entry points.  3. Production & Quality Control  Own the end-to-end promo production process from brief to final asset delivery. Quality check every stage, including writing, dubbing, audio mixing, video creation, and final output. Review scripts, VO/dubbing output, audio edits, video cuts, captions, and final creatives. Ensure every asset meets Pocket FM’s creative, language, production, and performance standards.  4. Dubbing Agency Management  Identify, evaluate, and onboard dubbing agencies for Brazilian Portuguese production. Coordinate with agencies for script handover, voice casting, recording, revisions, and delivery. Review dubbing output for pronunciation, emotion, pacing, tone, and character fit. Track agency timelines, pending deliverables, feedback loops, and final submissions.  5. Performance Reworks & Optimization  Review ads that are not meeting benchmark metrics and identify key creative issues. Create detailed and actionable rework hypotheses to improve ad performance. Suggest improvements such as stronger hooks, sharper conflicts, better pacing, improved localization, or revised visuals. Guide the team in creating alternate openings, new versions, and stronger creative angles. Apply campaign learnings to improve future promo concepts and execution.  6. Process, Tracking & Reporting  Maintain show-level trackers for all ads being written, adapted, dubbed, edited, reviewed, and delivered. Track ownership, status, timelines, delays, feedback, and final delivery for each asset. Share weekly progress reports with the India team and relevant stakeholders. Create SOPs, checklists, and workflows to avoid leakages across the production process.  7. AI Tool Adoption  Use GenAI tools for ad writing, ideation, VO production, image creation, video creation, and workflow improvement. Guide the team in using AI tools to improve speed, quality, and efficiency. Continuously explore new AI tools and workflows for promo production. Ensure AI-assisted outputs are reviewed for storytelling quality, cultural accuracy, and production readiness.  8. Market & Audience Understanding  Apply strong understanding of Brazilian consumer behavior, content consumption habits, and market trends. Ensure promos feel native, relevant, and compelling for Brazilian audiences. Stay updated on digital ads, audio entertainment, trailer formats, and performance creative trends.  Qualifications  Degree in Filmmaking, Marketing, Advertising, Media, Communications, or a related field. 8+ years of experience in ad creation, promo creation, trailer development, marketing creatives, ad copywriting, or performance creative production. Strong understanding of marketing, ad storytelling, promo creation, and audience engagement. Experience leading creative or production teams, including writers, editors, sound engineers, or external vendors. Excellent command of English and Brazilian Portuguese. Strong understanding of Brazilian consumer behavior, content consumption patterns, and cultural nuances. Experience working with dubbing agencies, VO artists, production teams, or post-production vendors. Skilled in GenAI tools for writing, VO production, image creation, video creation, and creative workflow improvement. Ability to create SOPs, trackers, review systems, and scalable creative processes. Strong analytical ability to review ad performance and convert insights into actionable creative reworks. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills. Strategic thinker with strong ownership and business growth orientation. Understanding of performance marketing on Meta and UAC is a plus.  Ideal Candidate  The ideal candidate is a creative leader who understands storytelling, promo production, and performance-driven advertising. They should be able to lead a multi-functional team, manage dubbing partners, maintain strong quality control, and deliver high-quality promo assets at scale. They should have strong knowledge of Brazilian audiences, excellent creative judgment, hands-on production understanding, and the ability to turn performance feedback into clear creative action. Language requirements  Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English  This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$ 7,000 - $10,000 BRL.

title: Project Manager
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Project Manager em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2B technology. This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development. About Ten16 CreativeTen16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership. We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.  About the RoleThe Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work. This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.  You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving. You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth. You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving. You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send. QualificationsThe ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment. They must be located in Brazil and must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. English fluency is essential because the role will involve written and spoken communication with U.S.-based team members and clients. Portuguese fluency is equally important for collaboration with Brazil-based team members and vendors.

You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind.  The Challenges You Will Face: 100% Remote Coordination:  Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity:  Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts.  If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let’s talk. Apply now and let’s make a global impact together!

title: Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Type:  Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration:  6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months. About the Role  We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn  to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation. Key Responsibilities  Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact  Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight  Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement  Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance  Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation  Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.  Required Qualifications & Experience  Technical & Operational Expertise  Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous.  Revenue & Churn Acumen  Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable.  Leadership & Stakeholder Management  Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.   Why This Role Matters  Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue. As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

Arquitetura e Design da Solução:  ➢ Escolher padrões e estilos arquiteturais adequados (micros serviços, filas de mensagens, etc.). ➢ Explicar o motivo da escolha dos estilos e padrões arquiteturais, considerando os requisitos de negócio, as restrições técnicas e os trade-offs envolvidos. ➢ Considerar os trade-offs entre simplicidade e flexibilidade. ➢ Definir estratégias claras para lidar com o aumento da carga (escalabilidade). ➢ Implementar mecanismos de recuperação de falhas (resiliência). ➢ Atender aos requisitos de alta disponibilidade. ➢ Definir como os componentes se comunicam (protocolos, formatos de mensagem, etc). ➢ Escolher ferramentas e padrões de integração adequados e suas responsabilidades. ➢ Implementar autenticação, autorização e criptografia (segurança). ➢ Implementar mecanismos de proteção contra ataques (WAF, etc). ➢ Selecionar ferramentas e tecnologias adequadas para implementar a arquitetura, considerando aspectos como desempenho, custo, facilidade de uso e integração com outros sistemas. ➢ Justificar a escolha de cada ferramenta/tecnologia, demonstrando um entendimento de seus prós e contras. ➢ Demonstrar análise de impacto da solução proposta e em diferentes domínios (Dados, Segurança, Infraestrutura, Soluções e Software, etc.). ➢ Demonstrar a estimativa de custo da solução proposta.  Documentação e Apresentação:  ➢ Documentar a arquitetura da solução de forma clara e concisa. ➢ Criar diagramas que representam a arquitetura da solução, incluindo os componentes, suas interações e os fluxos de dados. ➢ Centralizar documentações (Readme). ➢ Descrever possíveis melhorias ou expansões da solução. ➢ Demonstrar capacidade de visão e planejamento a longo prazo. ➢ Discutir trade-offs e desafios enfrentados durante o desenvolvimento.  Implementação e Operação:  ➢ Definir métricas de monitoramento para acompanhar o desempenho, a disponibilidade e a segurança da solução. ➢ Implementar alertas para detectar problemas e responder rapidamente. ➢ Descrever ferramentas e técnicas para coletar, analisar e visualizar as métricas.  Requisitos Diferenciais:  ➢ Definir os passos para migrar de um sistema de transição para a nova arquitetura (Arquitetura de Transição). ➢ Considerar os riscos e desafios da migração. ➢ Mapear os principais Riscos e Desafios identificados durante a proposta da solução. ➢ Descrever ações mitigatórias para os Riscos e possíveis soluções para os Desafios mapeados. ➢ Demonstrar conhecimento sobre as vantagens e desvantagens das tecnologias escolhidas. ➢ Demonstrar consciência dos tradeoffs envolvidos em cada decisão de arquitetura. Requisitos e qualificações Experiência: ➢ Experiência comprovada em projetos de arquitetura de soluções, com foco em integração de sistemas e otimização de processos. ➢ Experiência em análise de requisitos de negócios (funcionais e não funcionais) e transformação em soluções técnicas. ➢ Experiência com a definição e implementação de padrões arquiteturais (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.). ➢ Vivência em ambientes de desenvolvimento ágil.  Conhecimentos Técnicos:  ➢ Profundo conhecimento de padrões de integração de sistemas (APIs, mensageria, etc.). ➢ Sólido conhecimento de arquiteturas orientadas a micros serviços. ➢ Familiaridade com diferentes tecnologias e plataformas de desenvolvimento (ex: Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Cloud, etc.). ➢ Conhecimento de ferramentas de modelagem (ex: UML). ➢ Conhecimento de segurança da informação (autenticação, autorização, criptografia). ➢ Conhecimento de monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas. ➢ Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento de código (ex: Git). ➢ Conhecimento de estimativa de custos de infraestrutura e licenças.  Habilidades : ➢ Excelente capacidade de comunicação e negociação para influenciar stakeholders técnicos e de negócio. ➢ Visão sistêmica e capacidade de análise crítica para identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos e sistemas. ➢ Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em especificações técnicas claras e concisas. ➢ Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas embasadas em dados e em um profundo entendimento dos trade-offs envolvidos. ➢ Habilidade de documentar soluções de forma clara e organizada. ➢ Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento. title: Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer  Job Purpose  As Senior Windows Infrastructure Engineer, you are the technical anchor for the Windows estate that powers the managed services platform — a multi-client environment hosted on AWS. The work is grounded in deep Windows Server operations: Active Directory, IIS, hybrid identity, Group Policy, PowerShell, certificate services, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem. AWS is the platform on which all of this runs. Comfort with the cloud layer matters and you will operate it daily, but it is the Microsoft stack — and its operational nuance — that defines this role. We hire for deep Windows expertise first; the cloud layer is something a strong sysadmin can absorb. The estate is Windows Server 2019 and above, end-to-end. Linux footprint is negligible — this is a role for someone who wants to go deep on the Microsoft stack rather than be spread thin across platforms. This is a 100% individual contributor role. You will not manage or lead a team. You will own complex incidents end-to-end, set technical standards by example, and act as the senior escalation point for the Cloud Support function. Role Responsibilities  Lead resolution of complex Windows Server incidents across multi-client, AWS-hosted environments — from triage to root cause to remediation. Administer and harden Windows Server 2019/2022/2025: Active Directory (forest/domain design, replication, FSMO, GPOs, trusts), DNS, DHCP, IIS, WSUS, AD CS, file & print services. Operate hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ AWS Managed Microsoft AD, federation with Entra ID (Azure AD) / AD FS, SAML / OIDC / OAuth, Kerberos, MFA. Author and maintain PowerShell automation: bulk administration, scheduled tasks, configuration drift correction, reporting, and DSC where appropriate. Operate the AWS hosting layer for Windows workloads: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch, Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command), Backup, Directory Service. Manage IIS in depth: sites, application pools, bindings, ARR / URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, and performance tuning. Drive observability of the Windows estate: event log strategy, performance baselines, CloudWatch metrics & alarms, Grafana dashboards. Author runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles to codify operational standards. Participate in ITIL incident, problem, and change management; act as senior on-call escalation.  Essential Skills & Experience  Windows Server & Microsoft Infrastructure (Primary) 7+ years operating Windows Server in production, with deep hands-on experience on Windows Server 2019 and above. Active Directory at depth: forest/domain design, replication, FSMO roles, trusts, sites & services, schema, tombstone & recovery. Group Policy at scale: design, troubleshooting (RSoP, gpresult), security baselines, WMI filtering. IIS at depth: site & app pool configuration, ARR, URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, performance tuning. DNS, DHCP, WSUS, and Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) — real operational experience. Advanced PowerShell: scripting, modules, remoting, error handling, automation patterns, DSC familiarity. Windows patching at scale: planning, deployment, rollback, and troubleshooting in regulated environments. Windows performance troubleshooting: PerfMon, ETW, memory dump analysis, IIS request diagnostics.  Identity & Authentication Hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ cloud, Entra ID (Azure AD) Connect / federation, AD FS. SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, Kerberos, LDAP, MFA — practical implementation and troubleshooting. Certificate management and PKI in enterprise Windows environments.  AWS Hosting Platform (Operational Competence) Day-to-day comfort operating Windows workloads in AWS: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch. AWS Systems Manager for Windows fleet management: Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command, State Manager, Parameter Store. AWS Directory Service / Managed Microsoft AD / AD Connector. Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco? Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento. Sobre a oportunidade  Buscamos uma pessoa SAP ABAP Developer com experiência em SAP PM/EAM e soluções mobile SAP , para atuar em um projeto global relacionado à configuração, sustentação e evolução de soluções de mobilidade para manutenção. Principais responsabilidades:  Configurar, manter e evoluir soluções mobile SAP utilizando SYCLO Dynamic Forms  e/ou SAP Service and Asset Manager — SSAM . Elaborar documentação técnica e apoiar a disseminação de conhecimento dentro da equipe. Participar de reuniões e interações em inglês com stakeholders internacionais.  Requisitos obrigatórios:  Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas. Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento ABAP . Experiência com SAP PM/EAM — Plant Maintenance / Enterprise Asset Management . Conhecimento em processos de manutenção preventiva. Conhecimento em dados mestres de manutenção, incluindo Equipment, Classification e tabelas relacionadas . Experiência com Maintenance Plans, Maintenance Items e Maintenance Task Lists . Conhecimento em OData  e integrações SAP. Conhecimento em integrações e arquitetura SAP. Experiência com análise técnica, troubleshooting e sustentação de aplicações SAP. Vivência com desenvolvimento, manutenção e sustentação de soluções corporativas. Inglês avançado ou fluente para interação com equipes globais. (Obrigatório)  Diferenciais:  Experiência com SYCLO Dynamic Forms . Experiência com SAP Service and Asset Manager — SSAM  ou SAP Asset Manager . Experiência com soluções mobile SAP. Conhecimento em SAP Mobile Services . Vivência em integrações SAP com aplicações mobile corporativas. Experiência em ambientes industriais, manufatura, utilities, energia, mineração, papel e celulose ou óleo e gás. Experiência com processos de manutenção corretiva e preventiva em SAP PM/EAM . Conhecimento em arquitetura de integração SAP. Experiência com metodologias ágeis, como Scrum, Kanban ou similares . Vivência em ambientes multiculturais e projetos globais.

About Us   Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens. At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview   As the Team Lead for Portuguese Sketches, you oversee the end-to-end production workflow, ensuring high-quality, scalable, and timely delivery of localized content. You lead a cross-functional team and ensure alignment between English and Portuguese Sketches while maintaining strict audio, visual, and subtitle quality standards. In addition to overseeing production workflow, this role functions as a key operational stabilizer within the Portuguese content ecosystem. The Team lead ensures asset readiness, prevents production bottlenecks, bridges cross-time-zone collaboration, and safeguards content integrity across localized adaptations, enabling consistent and reliable execution at scale. Key Responsibilities   Leadership & Workflow Management  Team Leadership & Workflow Management:  Assign daily tasks, prioritize deliverables, and ensure smooth coordination across Video Editors and QC Specialists.  Production Continuity Ownership:  Ensure editors are never blocked due to missing assets, incomplete folders, or lack of resource preparation. Proactively prepare videos, audios, scripts, and subtitles before daily production begins.  Cross-Team Asset Coordination:  Act as liaison between Spanish/Portugeuse production, US content teams, and India stakeholders to request, follow up, and secure required assets in a timely manner.  Process Standardization:  Develop and maintain internal documentation (SOPs, transition guides, tracking frameworks) to support workflow clarity, team alignment, and smooth leadership transitions.  Reporting, Assets & Documentation  Reporting & Performance Tracking:  Submit daily performance reports and monitor output, quality, and timelines.  Asset & Process Management:  Oversee asset organization, repository accuracy, and workflow improvements to enhance efficiency and scalability.  Repository & Documentation Management : Maintain structured asset repositories, matching sheets, and tracking documents to ensure transparency and avoid duplication, inconsistencies, or production gaps.  Quality & Content Oversight  Quality Oversight:  Ensure full synchronization between visuals, audio, and subtitles; consistent visual style; complete audio mix (vocals, music, SFX); and no unintended logos or asset errors. English–Portuguese Alignment:  Maintain narrative and visual coherence between source and localized content. Content Integrity Assurance:  Monitor alignment between English source content and Portuguese localized assets across motion episodes, still episodes, promo videos, and thumbnails to ensure narrative coherence and platform consistency.  Operations & Issue Resolution  Technical Issue Resolution:  Address audio/video sync issues, asset inconsistencies, and day-to-day production challenges.  Daily Operational Troubleshooting:  Resolve audio inconsistencies, subtitle mismatches, CMS issues, visual discrepancies, and asset errors to maintain high production standards.  Reporting, Assets & Documentation  Reporting & Performance Tracking:  Submit daily performance reports and monitor output, quality, and timelines.  Asset & Process Management:  Oversee asset organization, repository accuracy, and workflow improvements to enhance efficiency and scalability.  Repository & Documentation Management:  Maintain structured asset repositories, matching sheets, and tracking documents to ensure transparency and avoid duplication, inconsistencies, or production gaps.  Operations & Issue Resolution  Technical Issue Resolution:  Address audio/video sync issues, asset inconsistencies, and day-to-day production challenges. Daily Operational Troubleshooting:  Resolve audio inconsistencies, subtitle mismatches, CMS issues, visual discrepancies, and asset errors to maintain high production standards. Risk Prevention & Escalation:  Identify operational risks (delays, inconsistencies, technical issues) early and escalate proactively to prevent impact on timelines and overall production output.  Qualifications  Bachelor’s degree in Audio Production, Linguistics, Media, or a related field. Intermediate to advanced English proficiency, with advanced knowledge of Portuguese grammar and orthography. Proven experience in quality control, audio/video production, or a related content operations role. Proficiency in Adobe Suite (including Premiere); familiarity with CMS platforms required. Experience reviewing AI-generated content is a plus. Strong attention to detail with a critical eye for audiovisual quality and consistency. Demonstrated leadership and team management experience. Excellent organizational, prioritization, and time management skills. Strong problem-solving abilities with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset. Demonstrated ability to act as operational backbone in high-volume content environments, ensuring production continuity and workflow stability. Proven experience anticipating production risks (asset gaps, sync inconsistencies, narrative misalignment) and implementing preventive solutions before escalation. Strong cross-cultural communication skills, with experience bridging expectations between international stakeholders (e.g., US and India teams) and local production teams. Experience building structured documentation, repositories, and tracking systems that enhance team clarity and reduce operational friction. Ability to maintain narrative and technical coherence despite creative divergence across markets. High level of ownership and accountability over end-to-end production outcomes. Strategic operational mindset with the ability to balance creative integrity, technical precision, and workflow efficiency.  Language requirements  Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English  This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$7,000 - $10,000 BRL.

title: AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese )
description:
Nova vaga disponível para AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese ) em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Company Description:  MillionLogics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, MillionLogics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results. Role Overview:  As an AI quality analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from your personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as grounding, integration, and helpfulness. Offer Details:   Duration of Contract : 12 months Pay:  $1500 per month (net/take-home) Mode of work:  Fully Remote Number of Positions:  20 Must have fluency in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese)   Key Qualifications:  Portuguese Proficiency : Ability to read and write in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese)  with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese  is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willing to use computer science, primary personal Google account (not a testing account), and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate the ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/laptop set up with a good internet connection.  Description:  In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.  Education & Experience:  BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., policy, law, ethics, linguistics, journalism, computer science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.  Additional Details:  Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Engagement Length: 12 months

We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts. Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You’ve worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges. You’ve owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you’ve navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build. About the Role  Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You’ll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into. A day’s work may include: Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems) Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data Contributing to Anterior’s SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture  Tech  Langs: Python / TS Infra: Nix, AWS Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you’ll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals)  What we’re looking for  Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours  What’s in it for you  This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You’ll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly. We offer  We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule). Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Fully remote. description:

About the Company  We are a leading digital asset platform that provides trading, brokerage, custody, and infrastructure solutions for institutional and professional investors. As the business continues to grow, they are seeking an experienced liquidity professional to lead and enhance their global liquidity capabilities. Role Overview  This leadership role is responsible for overseeing liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX markets in LATAM, ensuring efficient market access, strong execution quality, and robust liquidity coverage across trading products. The successful candidate will work closely with Trading, Sales, Product, Risk, Compliance, Treasury, and Technology teams to support the firm's institutional trading business. We cover stablecoins, on/off ramp and cross-border payments as well. Candidates with relevant experiences will be prioritized. Monitor market developments and identify opportunities to improve execution performance and pricing. Analyze trading activity, transaction costs, spreads, and execution metrics. Partner with trading and treasury teams to optimize execution workflows and market access.  Counterparty & Vendor Management  Build and maintain relationships with key liquidity providers and institutional counterparties. Support commercial negotiations, fee discussions, and service-level reviews. Conduct ongoing assessments and due diligence of trading venues and liquidity partners.  Risk & Governance  Work closely with Risk and Compliance teams to ensure appropriate controls and oversight. Monitor counterparty, settlement, and liquidity-related risks. Support contingency planning and business continuity measures during periods of market stress.  Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement  Lead and develop the liquidity function. Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Trading, Treasury, Product, Technology, Risk, and Compliance teams. Provide management reporting on liquidity performance, market developments, and strategic initiatives.  Requirements  Significant experience in liquidity management, electronic trading, FX trading, market structure, market making, brokerage, or institutional trading environments. Experience sourcing, evaluating, and managing relationships with liquidity providers, brokers, market makers, exchanges, and banking partners. Strong understanding of FX and/or digital asset liquidity ecosystems and execution practices. Ability to analyze execution quality, transaction costs, and liquidity performance metrics. Commercially minded with strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills. Experience working within regulated financial services environments. Excellent communication, leadership, and relationship management capabilities.

Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.  Description:  In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied. Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Diferenciais  –     Experiência com speech-to-text, diarização, processamento de áudio ou dados conversacionais ruidosos. –     Background em conversation intelligence, sales coaching ou analytics para call center. –     Experiência com fluxos de anotação, revisão humana ou otimização de custo e latência em IA. Você já colocou um pipeline de IA em produção, viu ele falhar de formas inesperadas com dados reais e construiu os mecanismos de avaliação para entender exatamente onde e por quê. Você não considera um modelo bom porque performou bem no benchmark: só quando funciona com os dados bagunçados do mundo real. title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Chinese)
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Remote AI Quality Analyst (Chinese) em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About Turing:   Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L. Role Overview:  As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness. Key Qualifications:  Chinese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Chinese with a high degree of comp, as Chinese is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.  Description:  In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.  Your day-to-day work will involve:  Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied. Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.  Education & Experience:  BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.  Offer Details:  Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week) Engagement type: Contractor Engagement Length: 3 months  After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.  Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

Vislumbramos um futuro em que a tecnologia e a engenhosidade humana atuam como aliadas do mundo natural, um futuro em que os dados orientam nosso caminho rumo a um modo de vida mais sustentável, equilibrado e resiliente, preservando o delicado equilíbrio do planeta para as próximas gerações. Somos uma empresa independente e lucrativa, com tecnologia comprovada e sistemas em operação em mais de 25 cidades no Brasil, em Portugal e em Itália, em rápido crescimento. Sobre a vaga  Esta é uma oportunidade única para quem quer vender com propósito e ter um impacto positivo no mundo real, trabalhando todos os dia para ajudar cidades a se tornarem mais resilientes.  Como Executivo de Vendas na greenmetrics.ai, você será a ponte entre nossas soluções tecnológicas e as necessidades urgentes das cidades brasileiras para melhorar sua capacidade de adaptação a eventos climáticos extremos, num momento em que o El Niño se apresenta como uma ameaça ao bem-estar e segurança das nossas comunidades.  No dia a dia, você vai prospectar novas oportunidades, visitar clientes, gerir o pipeline de leads, preparar propostas e fechar contratos que contribuem diretamente para criar cidades mais resilientes.  Seu trabalho vai contribuir para apoiar autoridades de emergência a priorizar áreas de risco, monitorar níveis de água em tempo real e tomar decisões informadas durante eventos extremos que se tornam cada vez mais frequentes e severos. Suas responsabilidades  Prospectar e qualificar oportunidades no Rio Grande do Sul. Agendar e conduzir visitas presenciais a municípios, apresentando casos de uso para monitoramento hidrológico e detecção antecipada de enchentes e alagamentos. Gerenciar o pipeline no CRM, garantindo dados atualizados e previsões de receita estimada. Gerenciar leads estratégicos e elaborar propostas comerciais. Negociar condições comerciais e acompanhar processos de compras públicas. Manter relacionamento com líderes municipais e fomentar expansão de contas. Representar a empresa em eventos, reforçando credibilidade técnica e institucional.  O que procuramos  +5 anos em vendas B2B ou setor público, preferencialmente em soluções tecnológicas ou SaaS. Histórico comprovado de performance com superação de meta, condução de ciclos de venda longos, contratos de alto valor, cases documentados e referências de clientes. Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, condução de reuniões executivas e apresentações técnico-comerciais. Experiência com ferramentas CRM e gestão de pipeline, métricas de funil e forecast. Negociação e gestão de stakeholders com postura colaborativa e foco em resultado. Autonomia e disciplina operacional para planejar rotas, viajar para visitas comerciais e cumprir agendas de campo com eficiência. Base na região metropolitana de Porto Alegre e disponibilidade para viajar (mandatório). Conhecimentos de engenharia, hidrologia ou tecnologia são desejáveis. Disponibilidade imediata ou no curto-prazo.  O que oferecemos  Salário fixo + comissões agressivas. Produto comprovado, de alto impacto social e ambiental e forte proposta de valor. Playbooks, ferramentas e mentoria do nosso time técnico e comercial. Ambiente hands-on, autonomia e impacto concreto e mensurável.  Como se candidatar  Sabemos que você tem uma rotina intensa e respeitamos seu tempo, então basta compartilhar seu currículo atualizado com os detalhes relevantes sobre sua formação e experiência. Inclua: sua experiência em vendas B2B ou setor público, exemplos de métodos e abordagens comerciais que você utilizou e principais resultados obtidos. Prazo de candidatura: 20/jun
